_comment: Mod interface. English is the base language: Minecraft falls back here when a key is missing in the player's language. Translation DATA lives in assets/skyblockru/packs/<lang>/ — this file is only the mod's own chat output.
skyblockru.diag.title: SkyblockRU — diagnostics
skyblockru.diag.colorguard: paragraphs left alone to keep their colors: %s
skyblockru.stats.title: SkyblockRU %s
skyblockru.stats.keys: hold %s to see the original English tooltip
skyblockru.stats.nopacks: no dictionaries for this language — the game stays English
skyblockru.packs.title: Optional dictionaries — switch to taste
skyblockru.update.nourl: No update address set (updateUrl in config.json)
skyblockru.update.fresh: Translations are already up to date
skyblockru.update.offline: Could not fetch the translation update (%s attempts). The translation still works and will update once the connection is back
skyblockru.telemetry.notice: The mod sends lines it could not translate, so the translation grows for everyone
skyblockru.telemetry.what: Only in-game text is sent. Never your name, profile or private messages
skyblockru.telemetry.off.done: Sending is off — the mod sends nothing
skyblockru.update.manual: Download it and put it in the mods folder yourself
skyblockru.problem.mixed: ⚠ mixed languages in %s line(s) — e.g. «%s». Worse than no translation; written to the dump.
skyblockru.problem.guard: ⚠ %s paragraph(s) translated but NOT shown — e.g. «%s». Paid text that never reached the screen.
skyblockru.problem.color: ⚠ %s line(s) lost colour — e.g. «%s». Fixed by marking the translation up.
skyblockru.problem.tooltips: ⚠ tooltip collection stopped: %2$s blocks reached, nothing new is recorded
